data.name: AZALE
data.detailed_description:
Become the Saviour of Lyrea

Embark on a journey through a world ravaged by corruption and darkness, wield magic to defeat countless monsters, take down the wrathful god that rules and uncover the secrets that led to the collapse of a thriving civilisation.

Key Features

  • Deep Deckbuilding Combat: Use your cards to summon powerful pieces and manipulate the board in your favour.

  • Over 200 Unique Cards: Huge variety in runs, with an incredible number of different strategies you can use on your adventures.

  • Meet New Allies: Fun characters with huge dialogue trees will be met as your journey through Lyrea; get to know them and learn about their pasts to uncover the deepest secrets of the world.

  • 100s of Ferocious Enemies: Encounter more enemies than you can count, each offering a unique challenge and forcing you to strategies to beat each and every one of them.

  • Explore the world of Lyrea, a land on the brink of Oblivion at the hand of a tyrannical god! Discover stunning environments, meet the cast of awesome characters and listen to the incredible score while on your adventure through the Fallen North.

  • Uncover hidden secrets and discover the lost history of Lyrea! Throughout the game you'll unlock new areas, new characters and new endings that reveal the shocking past of the world you're in.

Craft your Deck

As a Sorcerer, your deck is everything. Visit shops to expand it, and visit a variety of unique characters to upgrade it; make it as powerful as you can in order to take down the hundreds of creatures you'll encounter on your journey to Ascension.

  • Unlock over 200 Cards! Adventure in the Fallen North to expand your arsenal of Summons and Spells, all with a huge variety of unique effects and strategies, to take down your foes.

  • Enchant your Cards to be even Stronger! Several characters you'll meet on your journey will upgrade your cards in several different ways, all to bolden your own strategies and deck!

Stand Against Oblivion

The world is ending, and you are the only hope it has left. On your journey to Ascension, take down hundreds of unique creatures, all with different skills and traits that you'll need to learn to play around.

  • Defeat over 100 Unique Enemies! Vanquish everything in your path, from Imp Bandits, to Giant Carnivorous Plants to Ancient Beasts thought to have never even existed. Take them down with flawless strategy!

  • Challenge Legendary Bosses! Hone your skill and power to take down some of the most daunting and terrifying Fiends, Beasts and Warriors that the Fallen North has to offer!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-760; AMD Athlon II X4 645 AM3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 Super
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
